title: Pruned BPE: Post-training Visibility Pruning and Token Reallocation for Byte Pair Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2608.00837v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is widely used for subword tokenization, but standard BPE exposes every learned merge token to the downstream model, including tokens that mainly serve as intermediate construction units and rarely appear in the final encoded corpus. This paper proposes Pruned BPE, a post-training visibility-pruning and token-reallocation method that separates merge construction from model-visible vocabulary selection. After standard BPE training, tokens are evaluated by final exposure. Low-exposure tokens are retained as internal-only merge nodes, while their visible vocabulary slots are reassigned to better-exposed candidates learned through resumed training. During encoding, internal-only tokens are recursively expanded into visible descendants while the original BPE merge order is preserved. translated_title: 剪枝BPE：字节对编码的训练后可见性剪枝与词元重新分配
translated_abstract: 字节对编码被广泛用于子词分词，但标准BPE会将每个学习到的合并词元都暴露给下游模型，其中包括那些主要作为中间构建单元、很少出现在最终编码语料库中的词元。本文提出了Pruned BPE，这是一种训练后可见性剪枝与词元重新分配方法，将合并构建过程与模型可见词表的选择分离开来。在标准BPE训练完成后，根据最终暴露程度对词元进行评估。低暴露度的词元被保留为仅内部使用的合并节点，而其占用的可见词表槽位则被重新分配给通过恢复训练学到的、暴露度更高的候选词元。在编码过程中，仅内部使用的词元会被递归展开为可见的后代词元，同时保留原始BPE的合并顺序。在两个互不重叠的分别以英语和汉语为主的语料库及其组合上的实验表明，Pruned BPE持续……
tldr: 提出Pruned BPE方法，在BPE训练后将低暴露度的合并词元剪枝为仅内部使用的节点，并把释放的可见词表槽位重新分配给更高暴露度的候选词元，实现合并构建与模型可见词表选择的分离。
en_tdlr: Pruned BPE separates merge construction from model-visible vocabulary selection by pruning low-exposure tokens into internal-only merge nodes and reallocating their visible vocabulary slots to better-exposed candidates learned through resumed training.
